__comment: Grafana dashboard for the Phase-3c Per-Welle Trend-Heatmap (Noa Bergstroem / SRE, Tag-48 Mini-Welle, 2026-05-19). Consumes the structured JSON heatmap envelope written by scripts/observability/per-welle-trend-heatmap.py into state/per-welle-heatmap/yyyy-mm-dd.json. The dashboard's primary panel is a JSON-driven heatmap-stat-table whose cell color reflects the per-Welle verdict glyph ('G' green, 'C' yellow, 'N' grey, 'B' red) and the aggregate verdict glyph ('R' green, 'X' red). The dashboard is the at-a-glance posture surface during the daily cutover-readiness huddle (2026-05-19 through 2026-06-07 cutover-window). Schema version targets Grafana 10.x (schemaVersion >= 38). Anchors: ADR-0065 Phase-3c cutover-plan; ADR-0066 Doppel-Welle ordering; Reza Tag-44 PR #285 Daily-Trend-Analyzer; Noa Tag-46 PR #296 Mira-Notify chain; Noa Tag-47 PR #302 Alert-Bridge.
title: Wakir Persona-Engine - Per-Welle Trend Heatmap

panels.title: Per-Welle Verdict Heatmap (last $window_days days)
panels.description: State-timeline panel where each row is a Welle (1..7) or the aggregate, and each tick is one daily-probe snapshot. Cell color reflects the verdict bucket: GREEN/READY=green, CAUTION=yellow, NOT-EXEC=grey, BLOCK/NOT-READY=red, MISSING=transparent. Source: state/per-welle-heatmap/yyyy-mm-dd.json (re-rendered each morning at 06:05 UTC by scripts/observability/per-welle-trend-heatmap.py). Time-range follows the dashboard time-picker.

panels.title: Days BLOCK in window (aggregate)
panels.description: Number of days in the window where the aggregate verdict was BLOCK. Sandbox-stub baseline is BLOCK on every day (Welle-7 IIA-1130 gate fires by design). A drop below baseline means probes are diverging from the expected sandbox-stub shape and needs Mira-Hand-Sichtung.

panels.title: Missing-day count in window
panels.description: Days in the window without a daily-probe snapshot. >0 means the daily-probe workflow (phase-3c-pre-cutover-daily-probe.yml) failed or didn't run that day. Red threshold at 2 to surface multi-day gaps.

panels.title: Per-Welle stability (latest verdict count vs window)
panels.description: Per-Welle count of days in window matching the most-recent verdict. Mirrors the analyzer's stability_pct() metric in count-form for at-a-glance comparison. Healthy posture = all rows equal to window_days (i.e. no flips). Drops indicate verdict drift.
